scenarios.when: The user supplies texts and requests embeddings in a new absolute JSONL file.
scenarios.then: Preserve text order and contents, choose a reviewed exact model ID, validate request and output path before credentials, and invoke embedding once with only --host and --request. Report count, actual dimensions and the user path without vectors in chat.

scenarios.when: The user asks what embeddings are or how retrieval works.
scenarios.then: Read local guidance only; do not run init, doctor, models or a paid embedding request, create a database or index files.

scenarios.when: Input contains a filename or URL, or the user mentions a folder without selecting its contents.
scenarios.then: Do not scan, fetch or read implicit inputs. Obtain the explicitly selected texts and a new output file; no database creation or automatic ingestion.

scenarios.when: There are more than 64 texts, an overlong text, an oversized request or an existing output file.
scenarios.then: Stop before credentials and networking. Preserve inputs and existing files; explain the bound or request a new path. Never silently truncate, split into more paid requests, overwrite or remove files.

scenarios.when: The bound host returns a local credential-adapter or active-connection failure.
scenarios.then: Stop without init, doctor, models, another host, another credential or fallback transport. Only an explicit recheck or new verified evidence permits a relevant check on the same host.

scenarios.when: The response times out or cannot be validated, or an accepted response cannot be saved and verified.
scenarios.then: Preserve unknown, or accepted with output_verified=false for file failure. No polling, retry, replacement request or no-charge claim; explain possible billing before a user-authorized new attempt.

scenarios.when: The user explicitly asks for currently visible embedding models.
scenarios.then: Use models kind=embedding once, intersect GET /v1/models with reviewed exact IDs, and label visibility without claiming route, permission, billing or real-host acceptance. Ordinary embedding does not run this preflight.
